title: Audio player: transport, volume and waveform scrubber

summary: Brief attached: reuse MpiVideoControlBar transport, swap MpiTrimBar for MpiWaveform (MPI-730). Raised by Fabio mid-MPI-730.

plan.md written from the brief; maturity idea -> planned. Four plan-time decisions, all from the code: a SIBLING MpiAudioPlayer compound rather than a third mode of MpiVideoControlBar (attachSurface speaks MpiVideoSurface private API and most of the bar is frame math); it replaces the bare <audio controls> on the Flow result pane and the floating dock, nowhere else; volume is MpiProgressBar 0-100 not MpiFader (HTMLMediaElement.volume cannot use a dB scale with +12 boost); the player owns its <audio> and MpiWaveform still owns none, one instance per URL, MOVED not rebuilt so MPI-727 holds. A flow audio result already carries thumbPath + duration, so no route work. No jsdom in the node suite, so the check is a desktop spec on /voices/child_1.opus. types.js and preloadStyles.js are held by MPI-728, so their two registration lines are sequenced last.

Layout settled by Fabio against the live video player: ONE row, play | time | waveform | mute, and the volume is a VERTICAL slider revealed on hover over the mute button so the waveform keeps its width where the player is small. Drops the two-row layout the first plan had. His premise that MpiProgressBar already has a vertical option is wrong - orientation appears nowhere in it and git log -S vertical over its folder returns 0 commits; the gallery has two HORIZONTAL sliders (size + volume), and the only vertical slider in the app is MpiFader, a dB mix gain with +12 boost that HTMLMediaElement.volume cannot use. So a new item 1 adds orientation: vertical to MpiProgressBar (writing-mode: vertical-lr, native in Chromium 142 / Electron 41) before the player is built, keeping one Primitive as the source of truth for sliders. Five items now; the flyout is CSS :hover/:focus-within on a wrapper, no JS and no portal.

Scope grew on Fabio instruction: the mute+volume pair exists in TWO surfaces today (MpiVideoControlBar right cluster, MpiGalleryGrid header) and all three must match, so the hover-reveal control lands as its own MpiVolumeControl compound with three consumers. Plan is 8 items now. It owns no media element - forced, because the two existing rows disagree on what mute means: the video bar toggles video.muted, the gallery has NO mute button at all (its icon is a decorative span) and treats volume 0 as the mute; the gallery therefore GAINS a mute button. Still MpiProgressBar vertical, not MpiFader - Fabio read the first plan backwards; both existing surfaces are linear 0-100 bound to media.volume, so MpiFader would re-taper two shipped surfaces to dB and pull MPI-740 onto the critical path. Answered his MpiSlider hypothesis: MpiSlider DID exist and was deleted in 3c09fdbd, but the recovered file is 72 lines of wheel + prefix/suffix wrapper with no orientation and no vertical CSS - nothing was lost. Item 1 verify no longer uses js/pages/components.js: claimed by MPI-739 at 17:05Z.

reason: Plan approved by Fabio: layout (one row, vertical hover volume) and the consistency scope (the same control in the video bar and the gallery). files.json + checklist.md written, claim widened to the implementation files for items 1-5, 7 and 8. Items 1-5 touch only unclaimed files; the types.js/preloadStyles.js registrations (MPI-728) and the demo-page variant (MPI-739) are deferred, not blocking, and item 6 (MpiGalleryGrid) goes LAST because that file holds MPI-733 and MPI-678 uncommitted work.

summary: Item 1 SHIPPED and pushed (eeef13dc): MpiProgressBar takes orientation: vertical. writing-mode: vertical-lr + direction: rtl on the native range, so Chromium owns bottom-to-top pointer maths - not a rotate. JS writes height on the fill and bottom on the handle, in template and updateVisuals both. Every new CSS rule scoped under .mpi-progress--vertical, which none of the 23 existing mounts across 12 files emits. Verified in a real Electron window by tests/desktop/flow-audio-player.spec.js (the card spec, grows from here): tall thin track, fill anchored bottom and half-covered at 50, click near bottom reads LOW, click near top reads HIGH, and the horizontal control beside it still fills from the left with no leaked inline style. The bottom-to-top assertion was FALSIFIED first - with direction: rtl removed a bottom click reads 100 instead of under 20 and the spec fails on that line. eslint clean.
